location.site_descriptor: Mason County / Point Pleasant area; public sources describe a 2,250+ acre campus, but no verified street address was found in official sources during this refresh.

actions.government_body: West Virginia Office of the Governor
actions.result_status: HB 2014 Power Generation and Consumption Act and HB 2002 one-stop permitting bill signed in Point Pleasant near the future Fidelis 2,000-plus acre Monarch AI Data Center Campus.

actions.government_body: West Virginia Office of the Governor
actions.result_status: Governor statement acknowledged Nscale's announced plan to acquire AIPCorp, including Monarch Compute Campus in Mason County, and described the project expansion as enabled by microgrid legislation.

Nscale announced acquisition of AIPCorp/Monarch Compute Campus, a 2,250-acre Mason County site with an 8 GW-plus power runway; initial power capacity of 2 GW expected online in H1 2028 with expansion planned for 2031.
Nscale announced a Microsoft letter of intent for up to 1.35 GW of AI compute capacity using NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 systems, with delivery in multiple tranches beginning in late 2027.

actions.government_body: West Virginia Department of Environmental Protection, Division of Air Quality
actions.result_status: WV DEP NSR applications page lists Monarch Cloud Campus, LLC (MCC); Point Pleasant Campus, permit R14-0042, facility 053-00136, construction permit received 2026-04-20; no final permit shown in the listing.

actions.government_body: West Virginia Department of Environmental Protection
actions.result_status: WSAZ reported WVDEP ordered Monarch Cloud Campus to repair and strengthen stormwater controls after July 11 rainfall and required land-disturbing work to stop in one drainage area until controls were in place and WVDEP verified compliance.

capacity_basis.delivery_note: Phase 1 delivery targeted by early 2028 / multiple Microsoft tranches beginning late 2027; not operating capacity.

owner: Nscale Global Holdings Limited / Nscale Ltd.; WV DEP air permit applicant is Monarch Cloud Campus, LLC (MCC).

sources.match_reason: Official WV Governor and WV DEP sources confirm a Mason County / Point Pleasant Monarch project; Nscale confirms Monarch acquisition, Microsoft LOI, Phase 1 capacity, acreage, and long-term power runway.

contradictions.details: Nscale current pages and press releases state up to 2,250 acres / 2,250+ acres; some regional media/tracker sources describe 2,380 acres. Official/company-current value retained as 2,250+ acres.

WV DEP air construction permit R14-0042 remains an application with no final permit shown, while stormwater enforcement reporting indicates land-disturbing site work is underway. Status set to site work-construction, not energized or operational.

Nscale describes 1.35 GW Phase 1 AI compute capacity, 2 GW initial power capacity expected online in H1 2028, and an 8 GW-plus long-term power runway. capacity_mw uses the customer-facing Phase 1 AI compute figure and stores power runway separately.
